name: rk3576-whisper-c8
description: Copy of rk3576-whisper requesting an admission ceiling of 8, for the reComputer RK3576 Whisper concurrency-ceiling sweep with a voxedge main-branch wheel that adds max_concurrent to WhisperASRConfig (PyPI voxedge==0.0.13a0 lacks the field and clamps rk.whisper to 1 regardless of this value, per concurrency-cat-remote-ceiling.md). Same backend/build as rk3576-whisper (base, RKNN encoder at a 10s window, CPU ONNX KV-cache decoder).
